feature: Card captions — the modifiers below the art
note: The two card views that share `CardTileCaption`: `/collection`'s grid and the deck page's card view. Both draw the same two-line caption at the same fixed height, and the point of the design is that nothing sits on the illustration — so these cells are read for what the ART carries as much as for the caption. `/collection` is addressable (`?view=grid`); the deck's card view is NOT, because the toggle's choice lives in `localStorage` and no URL names it, so that row presses the control. `proxy-mark.json` records that press as timing out for the runner — MEASURED HERE AND IT DOES NOT: all four cells reached their surface on 2026-09-15. That note is stale and the row it blocks is buildable. Every `wait` names CONTENT (`h1`), never `main`: the runner already scopes each step through `onPage`, so a step that spelled `main` itself would ask for `main main` and wait out its timeout on a page that had rendered perfectly — which is how the first run of this file failed all four cells. The picture is the weaker artifact here either way: `pnpm probe:card-captions` MEASURES these surfaces across 24 checks and a contact sheet cannot see a 2px difference. It is here for what measurement cannot do — showing both routes got the feature at all, at both widths.

shares.note: Both routes render it directly — no wrapper — so each row's `view` is the file that imports it. The deck's undo receipt is deliberately NOT a row: it draws no caption of its own, and the `CARD_TILE_CAPTION_H` it borrows is a constant this check would not distinguish from the component.
